title: Area 51 equipment acquired from other governments
summary: John Harrington tells of Area 51 equipment acquired from other governments, about undated at Nevada test site and Area 51, and reads it from an official document. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: equipment in Area 51 because there is equipment there that we acquired from other governments.

plain: John Harrington, presented as a former US Secretary of Energy, says that there is equipment at Area 51, a secret military test site in Nevada, that the US acquired from other governments. He gives this as a reason the site is kept so closely guarded.
